ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Microsoft Teams Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed Microsoft Teams binary.

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "msteams\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "teams\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msteams\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\teams\\\.exe$")))
